messages:
nina (Partnerships): Quick thread to coordinate NewShore onboarding to Redwood marketplace. Key verticals: SSO (SAML/OIDC), SCIM provisioning, BYO-KMS/HSM integration, secrets connector smoke, and a short embargoed announcement cadence.

jas (PM): High-level checklist: 1) SAML metadata + OIDC fallback 2) SCIM user + group flows + bulk behavior 3) BYO-KMS wrap/unwrap & attestation 4) secrets end-to-end smoke 5) embargo + co-brand copy review.

kai (NewShore): We can provide an expiring SAML metadata URL, OIDC client creds for staging, SCIM v2 staging, and a single-tenant HSM gateway over VPN. Will upload artifacts to the partner bucket.

omar (Eng): Please include expected SAML attributes (email, name, groups) and NameID formats. Want OIDC scopes and token expiry too. For KMS, need p50/p95/p99 latency and concurrency limits.

kai (NewShore): Metadata: https://partners.newshore/staging/idp-meta.xml (48h). NameID: email and transient. OIDC scopes: open, profile, email. Token ttl 1h for staging. KMS staging metrics to follow.

rachel (Security): Requirements: IP allowlist template for SCIM webhooks, HSM attestation (X.509 cert + firmware hash), key policy draft for wrap/unwrap, signed SCIM option (mutual TLS or JWT). Can't enable BYO-KMS in Private until attestation + policy validated.

ben (SolutionsEng): Connector smoke plan: create user via SCIM, assign to a group, create secret in NewShore, rotate key, retrieve secret from Redwood runtime. I'll draft a mini-runbook and include retry/backoff for SCIM bulk.

omar (Eng): Runbook sample (staging):
```
# create user via SCIM
curl -X POST https://scim.staging.newshore/v2/Users \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <SCIM_TOKEN>' \
  -d '{"userName":"rbx-smoke","emails":[{"value":"eng+smoke@redwood.com"}]}'\

# create secret in NewShore
curl -X POST https://staging.newshore/api/v1/secrets \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <API_TOKEN>' \
  -d '{"name":"rbx/smoke","value":"s3cret"}'\

# fetch via Redwood runtime
REDWOOD_SECRET=newshore://rbx/smoke node scripts/get-secret.js
```

jas (PM): Tentative timeline: internal dry-run Mon, partner validation Tue, marketplace canary Thu. Legal asked for embargo dates + approved co-brand text by Tue 11:00 PT.

legal-bot: Reminder: upload the latest MSA redline to /collab/partners/NewShore before Tue 11:00 PT. Failure to upload may delay the joint announcement.

kai (NewShore): Understood. We'll push MSA redline, HSM attestation, and KMS telemetry by EOD tomorrow. We can also enable a VPN-hosted HSM endpoint for your test VPC.

rachel (Security): Two engineering blockers I listed: 1) SCIM bulk import throttling behavior and Retry-After semantics; 2) KMS concurrency and p99 latency for wrap/unwrap under load. Need numbers to size connector queues and timeouts.

kai (NewShore): SCIM supports chunked bulk with X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset headers and Retry-After when throttled. KMS staging: p50=3ms, p95=15ms, p99=48ms, max concurrent ops=220. We'll provide telemetry export.

ben (SolutionsEng): We'll implement exponential backoff with jitter and a small FIFO queue for bursts. Also add handling for Retry-After header in the connector.

omar (Eng): Ops note: can NewShore provide cert/thumbprint for their HSM gateway so we can automate attestation checks? Also need contact for VPN setup.

kai (NewShore): Yes, we'll include attestation cert and firmware hash. Infra contact is infra@newshore.com. For VPN, we'll accept your source IP ranges and client cert.

nina (Partnerships): Action items captured: 
- Kai: upload SAML metadata, OIDC creds, SCIM token, HSM attestation, MSA redline, KMS telemetry (by EOD tomorrow)
- Omar/Ben: finalize runbook + implement throttling/backoff handling (by Mon AM)
- Rachel: produce security checklist & IP allowlist template (today)
- Jas: draft embargo window + announcement copy (by Mon)

nina (Partnerships): I'll schedule a 30-min smoke-run call Wed 09:30 PT to walk the runbook and sign off checklist. Calendar invite will include the test harness & checklist.

jas (PM): I'll send the invite and include legal. Keep marketing copy internal until legal signs off on co-brand language. No external PR before both parties approve. :lock:

omar (Eng): I'll be on the call with the staging harness ready.

kai (NewShore): We'll join with infra lead and bring VPN details.

rachel (Security): I'll sign off on the checklist during the call.

ben (SolutionsEng): I'll attach connector test scripts to the invite.

nina (Partnerships): Thanks all 97 pulse check: anyone on the thread object to the timeline?

jas (PM): timeline looks good for my team.

kai (NewShore): Good from NewShore.

rachel (Security): No objections.

legal-bot: once MSA is uploaded, please add a short summary of co-brand phrases to /collab/partners/NewShore/copy-approval.

nina (Partnerships): Closing note: keep marketplace listing minimal until legal clears co-brand wording and we have BYO-KMS attestation verified.

kai (NewShore): Acknowledged. Thanks everyone.
